concepts.gloss_en: The phrase/divine designation 'Hashem Elokai' (Hashem my God)
The unification/yichud of 'Hashem Elokai' — an act of unification, not the phrase itself

members.note: representative; construct head is יחוד (unification), a distinct concept from ה אלקי per rule 4 (action about X ≠ X)

notes: Both occur in lm1:54 and overlap in tokens, but 'יחוד ה אלקי' names the act of unification whose object is 'ה אלקי'. Different construct heads — kept separate per rule 4.
